action.objective: Verify a4c5 as the reserved candidate at full depth before committing.
action.rationale: Reserved verification for a4c5 at depth 4 with 2000 nodes. This is the only exact-evidence top row; all others are upper bounds. c5 attacks the a5 queen and the b7/d6 squares, expanding activity. Verifying at depth 4 gives a like-for-like basis before committing.
